data.name: Introduction
data.value: Edit a bounded public scope, preview changes, then explicitly apply them to this workspace.

data.name: ReplaceScope
data.value: Replace represented scope: omit missing keys

data.name: CanonicalScope
data.value: Supplied public answers and explicit omissions only, not a complete backup. Protected settings and excluded compound regions remain in Form.

data.name: EnvironmentScope
data.value: Only active, unambiguous direct scalar mappings are editable. Read-only, protected, inactive, ambiguous and controlling settings remain outside this scope.

data.name: CoverageHelp
data.value: This list contains admitted definition metadata, never your answers. Use Form for excluded settings.

data.name: ConsentPending
data.value: The editor is waiting for workspace consent.

data.name: ConsentRequired
data.value: No editor or source has been opened. Anything you type or paste is private, even in a public-scope document. Review the existing workspace consent control to continue. Accepted secrets are never prepopulated.

data.name: EditorHelp
data.value: Pending text and undo history stay in this private editor until retirement. Tab leaves the editor. Preview never applies changes. Formatting is explicit; invalid text is retained. Environment formatting removes comments and normalizes to LF without a BOM.

data.name: Ready
data.value: Nothing is applied while you type.

data.name: Changed
data.value: Pending text or application mode changed. Parse again to refresh the preview.

data.name: PreviewReady
data.value: Preview ready. Accepted workspace answers are unchanged until Apply.

data.name: Invalid
data.value: The document cannot be applied. Correct the indicated code and location; pending text is retained.

data.name: SourceUnavailable
data.value: Source could not be opened. Resolve invalid supplied values or pending Form drafts within this scope, then reopen. No Form draft was discarded.

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: The local editor is unavailable. No fallback editor or remote service is used. Form remains available; reopen after the local editor assets are ready.

data.name: Retired
data.value: The previous editor, history and preview have been retired. Reopen explicitly to edit the current workspace.

data.name: Applied
data.value: Applied to this workspace. The same text and undo history remain; no automatic formatting or reload occurred.

data.name: AppliedEditorUnavailable
data.value: Applied to this workspace, but the local editor could not be rebound. This was not a rejection. Review the workspace before reopening the editor.

data.name: AppliedObserverFailed
data.value: Applied to this workspace, but an observer failed after commit. This was not a rejection. Review the current workspace before continuing.

data.name: Formatted
data.value: Formatted pending text without applying it. Parse again to preview changes.

data.name: HistoryLimited
data.value: History is limited to 100 undo groups and a 4 MiB retained-text budget. Older history may be retired; edits exceeding the budget are rejected, not silently truncated.

data.name: InvalidJson
data.value: Invalid JSON syntax. Correct the document before applying.

data.name: InvalidEnvironment
data.value: Invalid Environment syntax. Use an uppercase key and a supported single-line value.

data.name: CanonicalCoordinates
data.value: Canonical admission errors currently use document-level coordinates. The local editor supplies syntax markers.

data.name: EnvironmentCoordinates
data.value: Coordinates refer to the acquired source before line-ending normalization. The constrained codec, not shell syntax, determines valid input.

data.name: DiagnosticsTruncated
data.value: Only the first 100 diagnostics are shown. Correct them and parse again.

data.name: CanonicalSummary
data.value: Public-scope replacement: absent from both values and omitted resets only that captured scope; omitted suppresses initialization. Excluded regions are unchanged.

data.name: MergeSummary
data.value: Merge: supplied keys set represented answers. Missing keys retain existing answers and omissions. Unrepresented settings are unchanged.

data.name: ReplaceSummary
data.value: Replace represented scope: supplied keys set answers; missing represented keys become explicit omissions. Unrepresented settings and defaults are not reset.

data.name: ApplyBoundary
data.value: One atomic workspace update. Missing required answers remain Review work. Preparation does not grant target acceptance or administration.

data.name: PendingHelp
data.value: Apply valid text, discard the private document and history, or stay here. Invalid text is retained after a failed Apply. Revoking consent always retires it immediately.
